# ex: match index expression
ex {
	var m map[string]int
	m["key"] -> m["default"]
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(m map[string]int) int {
	return m["key"]
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 package m

 func F(m map[string]int) int {
-	return m["key"]
+	return m["default"]
 }
